deliberately_narrow: 38 sections carry a denial followed by substantial content; only 3 are contradictions. pn-report denies a GRADE rating and then shows a summary-of-findings table whose certainty column is an em dash -- that is honest. A rule flagging all 38 would train a reader to ignore it.

reverted_because_the_panel_is_a_stub.why: Removing the denial left pn-search holding a query and an EMPTY yield table. The pre-push regression check caught it at once as ssot_empty_panel with an absent-state reason of zero characters: the element that explained an empty panel was gone and the panel was still empty. THE DENIAL WAS DOING REAL WORK WITH THE WRONG WORDS. Deleting it fixed a false sentence and created a silent gap, which is the trade this project refuses.
reverted_because_the_panel_is_a_stub.what_is_owed: The third state must be written by the BUILDER rather than patched into pages: HELD (query, date and yield), PARTIALLY HELD (query held, yield not), NOT HELD (nothing, and why). These seven are PARTIALLY HELD and currently say NOT HELD. Recorded, not fixed.
